description: This file defines functions and constants for managing network routing rules using netlink in Go, including adding, deleting, and listing rules, as well as handling rule attributes and filtering.

methods.name: RuleAdd
methods.description: Adds a network rule to the system, calling the handle method.

methods.name: RuleDel
methods.description: Deletes a network rule from the system, calling the handle method.

methods.name: RuleList
methods.description: Lists all rules for a given family.

methods.name: RuleListFiltered
methods.description: Retrieves rules filtered by a template and mask.

methods.name: ruleHandle
methods.description: Handles the creation or deletion of a rule by constructing netlink messages.
